ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with high-intensity (white) regions concentrated at the distal lobe tips, approximately an 80:20 black-to-white macro-ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-contrast white patch on the distal region of the left lobe; fragmented white mottling and pixelated spotting on the distal region of the right lobe; solid low-intensity black pigmentation across the proximal and central fluke regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 40-degree internal angle and high bounding-box depth relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the linear boundary; high-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude peaks and valleys across the entire trailing edge, with increased jaggedness at the distal terminals.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning into a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-intensity circular nodes (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; secondary faint grey circular depressions scattered across the central black surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, unaligned high-contrast linear marks; notable horizontal scratch on the lower right lobe and several diagonal linear disruptions on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips and multiple visible linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry; the left lobe distal tip features a solid white block, while the right lobe distal tip features a 'splattered' or fragmented white-on-black pixel distribution.
